set.body:
Goal: turn conformance into inspectable release evidence.

Acceptance criteria:
- Generate validation/eyes4s-eyelink-validation-<version>.json through a fail-closed, deterministic generator.
- Artifact binds eyes4s source revision, dirty state, schema version, support matrix, corpus and oracle digests, converter identities/options, JVM/Scala.js results, differential metrics, mutation receipts, performance evidence, warnings, and unsupported configurations.
- Generation refuses dirty or mismatched source unless an explicit development mode marks the artifact non-release.
- A drift suite recomputes scientific inputs and fails if the committed artifact is stale or hand-edited.
- Public aggregate evidence reveals no private gaze content while retaining fixture hashes and coverage cells.
- Local generation is followed by clean hosted verification before a support claim is released.
- Artifact SHA-256 and scientific digest are reported in the owning Mote completion note.
set.title: Generate the release-bound EyeLink validation artifact
